hero.headline: Building Reliable Infrastructure
hero.description: We help development teams release applications with confidence through cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring that keeps applications running smoothly.
hero.supportingText: My work connects infrastructure and development teams so releases are faster, safer, and easier to recover when something breaks.

about.title: About Me
about.intro: I focus on building reliable cloud systems, clean deployment workflows, and infrastructure that helps teams ship with confidence.
about.description: My background connects DevOps, backend development, and automation, so I enjoy turning complex setup work into simple, repeatable systems.
about.quote: I build systems so teams can move faster without losing the confidence to recover when things go wrong.
about.note: I recharge with movies and music, then bring that calmer, more creative mindset back into problem solving.
